full_package.repository_policy: Large/binary campaign packages and future measurement RAW payloads remain outside Git; this index preserves the compact scientific contract and package hash.

key_efficiency_rules: Run gain-state reconnaissance before full PTC.
Uniform flat RAWs may support PTC pre-GainMap and residual shading after exactly one GainMap, with separate models/validation.
Slanted edges may support both SFR and lateral CA.
Point sources may support both PSF and chromatic centroid displacement.
Neutral target fields may support Level-N illuminant mapping and neutral-axis validation.
hard_boundaries: Use one physical color target instance as both fit target and final validation target.
Use a TruthRaw-derived/reconstructed DNG as calibration input.
Fit physical PSF/MTF from arbitrary dog/house/nature scene texture.
Use clipped WhiteLevel codes as exact latent radiance.
Treat AsShotNeutral as a measured illuminant SPD.
Use the black/white-dog uncertainty holdout to retune the frozen v5.0g model.
promotion_rule: FULL_PHYSICAL may be asserted only for an explicitly enumerated camera/lens/mode/gain/illuminant/focus/source domain in which every required measurement and independent validation gate passes. No pass may be inferred across unmeasured domains.
broad_scope_uncertainty_rule: The frozen black/white-dog high-risk failure is not fit data. Broad high-ISO tele scope requires new independent uncertainty evidence or an explicitly narrower certificate scope.
